title: Notification Settings: once a member saves digest or quiet hours, the page offers no way back to following the organization default
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · split off #36369 at ACCEPT 7101525096 on PR #36694, on seat 3's filing request (#32588 comment 7101547116). Origin: contract review 7076382062 on PR #36326 (#35123, ruling 7073270426). Parent topic #36240.

## What happens

A member opens Notification Settings and saves a digest or a quiet-hours choice. From then on that page offers no action that returns the member to following the organization's default. The Setup grid can clear the field for them, but the member's own page cannot. To undo a personal choice, a member has to ask an admin, or pick values that only happen to match today's default. Those values then stop tracking the default when it changes.

## Done when

- The member's Notification Settings page offers a 「跟随组织设置」 action for digest and for quiet hours. It clears the member's own value, the same way the Setup grid does.
- After clearing, the page shows the organization's current value as inherited, and a later change of the organization default reaches that member.
- A test pins the round trip: save a personal value → clear it → the resolver answers the org default.

Triage: lands in `area:workflow` · `domain:ui` · `priority:p2` · Feature · `pm:queue`; rationale: visible behaviour on a member-facing settings page with no way back, so a personal choice becomes permanent unless an admin intervenes. No wrong delivery and no error, so p2 (UX has no p3).
